name: Fleet
author: Rolf Koenders
description: The health of your fleet of machines in the Omarchy bar: conflicts, unreachable hosts and stopped timers at a glance.

barWidget.description: Fleet health: one row per host, with its last apply and timer, and shortcuts into the fleet bridge

schema.label: Check interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to run fleet status --all. Press r in the panel to check now.

schema.label: Not seen after (hours)
schema.description: A host that has not answered for this long turns the icon amber.

schema.label: Fleet command
schema.description: The fleet to run. Plain words and paths only.

schema.label: Terminal command
schema.description: Opens fleet bridge in a terminal window, or focuses the one that is open. Plain words and paths only.

schema.label: Keep the bar icon unlit
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar's colour whatever the state. The count and the panel still show it.
